items.title: The Thunder Gate
items.task: Find the enormous lantern. Then look underneath it. What detail do most visitors miss?
items.notes: Do not print the missed detail in the hook. Keep it for the family.

items.title: Temple + Shopping?
items.question: Why would shops grow along a temple approach?
items.reveal: Temple visitors created foot traffic. Where people gathered, merchants and food sellers followed.

moreInfo.title: The road to the temple
moreInfo.text: This is one strong reason streets like Nakamise filled with shops. It is not the sole historical explanation for every stall here.

items.notes: Do not present foot traffic as the only origin of every Nakamise shop.

items.title: Why Is Everyone Waving Smoke?
items.task: Watch what people do with the incense smoke. What do you think it means?
items.reveal: Visitors often draw incense smoke toward themselves as part of a popular devotional custom.

moreInfo.title: A custom, not a rule
moreInfo.text: The smoke is traditionally associated with blessing or purification. This is a popular custom, not a universal Buddhist rule, and it is not medicine for specific body parts.

items.notes: No medical-healing claim. Not presented as a universal Buddhist rule.
